Indie Makers Forum: community guidelines

Welcome! This forum is for people who build small software products on their own.

  1. Be kind and assume good intent.
  2. Share what you are building, but do not turn threads into ads. Self-promotion is not allowed outside the Show & Tell category.
  3. Each member may start at most one new topic per day.
  4. Links are welcome as long as they are relevant to the discussion.
  5. Automated accounts will be banned without warning.

Moderators may edit or close topics that break these guidelines.
